gate: b1 decoder alone (oracle ids, oracle fp32 image_embeds -> fp16, zero-padded to 256 rows)

oracle.oracle: checkpoint decider/vision.py VisionDecisionModel.prepare() -> slot_logits(), fp32, CPU, torch.no_grad

readout: S=1 from fresh zero states through the whole row, logits at every slot step, letters ids 32.. over the first nopts, softmax T=1 (float64)

bar.full_vocab_top1: the oracle's argmax letter on all slots
bar.reset: bit-equal slot logits in every process
bar.mean_of_run_mean_abs_dp_definition: mean over runs of the mean |dp| over all (slot, option) entries of the run

environment.runtime: coreai python runtime, AOT h16c GPU .aimodelc, SpecializationOptions.default(), no JIT
environment.gpu: shared with other sessions, no _GPU_LOCK (times are contended reference values)

red_arm.arm: image_embeds zeroed (image ids and rope unchanged)

trimmed.serialization: compact json (no indentation) to keep the repository small; the full copy is pretty-printed
